In recent years, while several tools for core natural language understanding tasks involving syntactic and semantic analysis have been developed for noisy social media text BIBREF0 , BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 , BIBREF3 , there is little work on question answering or reading comprehension over social media, with the primary bottleneck being the lack of available datasets. One major challenge of building a QA dataset on tweets is the sparsity of informative tweets. Many users write tweets to express their feelings or emotions about their personal lives. These tweets are generally uninformative and also very difficult to ask questions about. Given the linguistic variance of tweets, it is generally hard to directly distinguish those tweets from informative ones.
